texts:
.subckt TL431 cat ref an
* reference input current about 2 uA
Rref ref an 1.25Meg
* the cathode current rises steeply once REF is above 2.495 V (200 A/V; a smooth knee 0.3 mV wide, so that Newton's iteration always has a slope to follow; and the cathode is above ~1.2 V)
Bk cat an I=0.06*(0.5*(((V(ref,an)-2.495)/0.0003)+abs(((V(ref,an)-2.495)/0.0003)))+ln(1+exp(-abs(((V(ref,an)-2.495)/0.0003)))))*step(V(cat,an)-1.2,0.2)
Rleak cat an 10Meg
.ends TL431

.subckt TL431 cat ref an
* reference input current about 2 uA
Rref ref an 1.25Meg
* the cathode current rises steeply once REF is above 2.495 V (and the cathode is above ~1.2 V)
Bk cat an I=limit(200*(V(ref,an)-2.495),0,0.1)*step(V(cat,an)-1.2,0.2)
Rleak cat an 10Meg
.ends TL431
descriptions: TL431 可変シャント・レギュレータ(基準電圧 2.495V、SOT-23, ピン1=CATHODE 2=REF 3=ANODE)。REF が 2.495V になるようカソード電流が流れる。外付け抵抗の分圧で 2.5〜36V に設定。簡易モデル(数値は概算)。ピン配置は必ずデータシートで確認
